Rule 65 governs the grant of a certificate of sale of immovable property to the purchaser after the sale has become absolute. The confirmation order (dated April 20, 2026) is passed under Section 28A read with Rule 63(1), which obliges the Recovery Officer to confirm the sale once no application has been made under Rule 60 to set aside the sale and the full purchase money has been paid. Rule 63(1) therefore makes the sale absolute, and Rule 65 authorises the subsequent issue of the sale certificate.
review_notes: Sale certificates cite Rule 65 and the confirmation order cites Rule 63(1); both rules and their sequence are directly supported by the cited chunks.

question: Four properties were confirmed in SEBI's April 2026 e-auction across Bishal Group, GSHP Realtech and MBK Business Development. Three went to sole bidders who bid and paid; the fourth did not. Which property was the exception, and what happened to the original highest bidder?
answer_summary: The exception was Bishal Group's S. No. BG8. The confirmation order lists two bidders for BG8 — Questqueen Properties LLP and Samiul Ali Shah — and states that the sale was knocked down to Samiul Ali Shah as the second highest bidder because the highest bidder had defaulted in making payment. The BG8 sale certificate records Samiul Ali Shah as the declared purchaser for Rs. 46,90,159 plus 1% poundage fee.
review_notes: Confirmed: BG8 was knocked down to second-highest bidder Samiul Ali Shah after the highest bidder defaulted, matching the confirmation order and BG8 sale certificate.

question: Using the February 2026 public notice and the April 2026 sale-confirmation order, compare the published reserve price with the knocked-down bid for each of the four confirmed properties. Which property sold for exactly its reserve price, and by how much did the others exceed their reserves?
answer_summary: | Property | Reserve Price (Rs.) | Knocked-down Bid (Rs.) | Difference | |---|---|---|---| | BG6 | 92,07,196 | 92,07,720 | +524 | | BG8 | 46,40,159 | 46,90,159 | +50,000 | | G1 | 33,52,555 | 34,02,555 | +50,000 | | MBK2 | 86,69,273 | 86,69,273 | 0 | MBK2 was purchased at exactly its reserve price. The other three attracted premium bids.
